rules: No mission replay — save manually at the start and end of every chapter.
Cheats disable trophies and saving. Keep them off for the whole run.
Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent, and the police get far more aggressive.
Some questlines are locked to one character: Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only.
Quests marked with an hourglass expire — but they do not count for any trophy.
The 100% Completion Checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but progress you make during the story already counts.

stages.summary: Play the 5 chapters and take optional missions and character quests as they appear. Scan vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars along the way — 200 vehicles scanned and 100 animals studied feed the 100% checklist later.
stages.title: The story — play it, do things as they appear
watchouts: MISSABLE: Positive Mental Attitude. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in the morning — before Chapter 1 ends.
Do not skip the Lucia balcony meditation. It is the game's only potentially missable trophy, and it is unconfirmed whether that first meditation counts — doing it is the safe choice.
Turn on every progress and collectible notification in the settings before you start.

stages.summary: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work what is left. It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, and you need 70 of the 80 challenges. Everything on this stage is still available in free roam.
stages.title: The 100% checklist — the long grind
watchouts: Required in full: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.
Only 70 of 80 challenges are needed — skip the hardest 10.
Card sets: 15 complete sets for 100% (the trophy needs 3). Stunts: 300 for 100% (the trophy needs 250).

stages.summary: Finish the stranger strands (not part of 100%), the partner crimes and the odd one-off moments. Once the story is over, every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back.
stages.title: Cleanup — Strangers & Freaks and the leftovers
watchouts: Stranger missions are not part of 100% — but Strangers & Freaks needs 8 strands.
Partner trophies need your partner beside you: Hot Together and Retail Therapy.
Check the tracker below and finish whatever is still unchecked.
